# 正定矩阵

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display

A = Matrix([
    [2, 6],
    [6, 18],
])
display(A.is_positive_definite)
display(A.is_positive_semidefinite)

A = Matrix([
    [2, 6],
    [6, 19],
])
display(A.is_positive_definite)
```

[sympy 有函数判断正定吗？](../appendices/25.md#sympy-有函数判断正定吗)

[sympy 里有函数算二次型吗？](../appendices/25.md#sympy-里有函数算二次型吗)

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display

A = Matrix([
    [2, -1, 0],
    [-1, 2, -1],
    [0, -1, 2],
])
display(A.is_positive_definite)
for i in range(3):
    display(A[: i + 1, : i + 1].det())
display(*A.LUdecomposition())
display(A.LUdecomposition()[1].diagonal())
display(A.eigenvals())
display(A.trace())
```

[sympy 取主子式，算主元，算特征值，算二次型](../appendices/25.md#sympy-取主子式算主元算特征值算二次型)
